description: This source file defines classes for normalizing function argument signatures and operator call sites within the PyTorch FX framework. It includes the NormalizeArgs transformer for argument normalization and the NormalizeOperators transformer for canonicalizing operator calls.

classes.name: NormalizeArgs
classes.description: Transformer class for normalizing function arguments to match expected signatures and optionally converting positional args to kwargs.

classes.name: NormalizeOperators
classes.description: Transformer class that normalizes different calling conventions of operators to a canonical form within FX graphs.
